title: Rising attacks in Middle East pushes oil higher
section_path: Rising attacks in Middle East pushes oil higher
section_path_text: Rising attacks in Middle East pushes oil higher
summary:
Main
A focus on supply issues pushed commodities higher. Energy gained, as attacks in the Middle East intensified, while a stronger USD weighed on precious metals. By Daniel Hynes
Image reference: Στιγμιότυπο οθόνης 2026-11-20 123342.png | assets/2026-11-20_rising-attacks-in-middle-east-pushes-oil-higher_img_cea3cf84ceb9ceb3cebcceb9cf8ccf84cf85_10f8d9da619d.png

Market Commentary
Copper finally found some support following a wave of selling earlier this week.

children.summary: A focus on supply issues pushed commodities higher. Energy gained, as attacks in the Middle East intensified, while a stronger USD weighed on precious metals.

children.title: Market Commentary
children.summary: Copper finally found some support following a wave of selling earlier this week. The metal has lost more than 11% this month as traders unwound bullish bets.

children.title: Chart of the Day
children.summary: China has helped buffer the blow to Middle East aluminium supply, by boosting its output and exports this year. However, declining profitability could reverse that trend.
